answer: A script can invent a name in a millisecond; it cannot invent a decade. Paramedic registration with ambulance service attestation is the decade: two-year training, 750 supervised callouts, registration exam, annual re-assessment. The cedar is the ledger entry dated years ago, made for a purpose that had nothing to do with this epoch. To fake a hundred accounts the ring must stage a hundred such decades, and the lotus in each is the mundane evidence — receipts, visits, signatures, collected one by one. The glacier is the registry lookup, finished before the applicant has sat down.
